turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're relocating for my job and I can't choose which part of the city to live in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Riverside has lovely old houses and a great primary school, but it's pricey and a long commute for me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Northgate is cheap and lively, with tons of bars and cafes, but the schools aren't great.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's Ashby, a new estate on the edge of town, quiet, big gardens, but you need a car for everything.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the town centre itself, flats only, walking distance to my office, not much green space.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If school matters most, Riverside is the strongest pick, even with the commute. Northgate suits you if you'll be out a lot, and Ashby only makes sense if you're happy driving everywhere.
